items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: Eddie Atkins worked with Joe Oliver for a long time.

ctx.x: Remember Eddie Atkins? Yeah, he was a good trombone player. Who did they work with?
Eddie Atkins worked with Joe Oliver for a long time. Down here? Yeah. They had a good band. He's there too, huh?
Yes, he is. I've been to his grave. They buried out in Amor, up near Wagamon.
